source.commit_body:
Score-stage gradient lift for puts in [16,20] near upcoming earnings,
replacing the EARN_SUPP_PUT cascade-stage filter (shipped 2026-04-26,
10 days live).  The score itself now drifts these signals OUT of put-
qualifying range so the dashboard doesn't show them as red badges
the strategy will silently skip.

Mechanism (gradient over thresholds, applied BEFORE EARN_BOOST):

    if 16 <= overall <= 20 and 1 <= days_to_earnings <= 7:
        # Score gradient: peaks at 16-20, fades width 3
        score_grad = clip((overall-13)/3, 0, 1) for 16-17
                    OR clip((23-overall)/3, 0, 1) for 18-20
        # Proximity: 1.0 at d=1-5, fades to 0 at d=8
        proximity = 1.0 if d <= 5 else (8-d)/3
        weakness  = score_grad * proximity
        overall  += 0.95 * weakness * (28 - overall)

Target=28 places the lifted signal just past the <25 put-qualifying
threshold AND past EARN_BOOST's put gate (overall<=25), so subsequent
EARN_BOOST won't re-amplify on the put side.

Calibration via fast_variant_runner sweep
(experiments/pess_v39/sweep.py, 11 variants on v37 5y).  Per-trade
<25 cumulative impact is small (+0.06pp Δ) because v37 PCD already
filtered most of the cohort; the residual (~65 puts/year) is what
PESS targets.  Portfolio impact comes from cascade slot displacement
(matching the original EARN_SUPP_PUT N=1000 MC validation: +44.7%
5y compound Realistic).

Per-trade gate (sub-25 H1 fix per assessment-backtest.md, soft):
  - <25 TP%: +0.06pp / N -2.3% (cohort dampened out of universe)
  - <20/<15/<10/<5: within ±0.4pp (gradient edges only)
  - Calls: byte-identical (gate is puts-only)
  - Multi-window: 3y -0.02 / 1y -0.20 (small cohort, within tolerance)

Applies stoch_grad smoothly so signals on the wadj-mild edge of
the cohort get partial dampening (per "gradient over thresholds"
ship guidance).

Retires the EARN_SUPP_PUT filter:
  - strategy_config.py: EARN_SUPP_PUT = False (both DTEs)
  - trader.py: EARN_SUPP_PUT = False
  - frontend StockTable.js: EARN_SUPP_PUT skip badge removed
    (no API will emit this reason now that the filter is off)

Builds atop v38 CWWD (commit b093e2d) — both score-stage fixes
encode their cascade-stage filter ancestors as proper score
adjustments, eliminating the dashboard divergence problem.
